react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings persist across the app: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow".' Migrate to RN 0.76+ box/textShadow. No functional impact. Reference: multiple StyleSheet.create() sites (e.g. /app/frontend/src/components/web/GeometryEditor.tsx:720 uses textShadowColor/textShadowRadius).

action_items: Main agent: WEB-EDITOR-1 (marquee select 2+ shapes → align top → Ctrl+Z), WEB-EDITOR-2 (drag-move OKN-99 60px → mongo pozycja_x increase → Ctrl+Z restore), WEB-EDITOR-3 (resize OKN-99 via bottom-right handle → mongo w/h changed), WEB-EDITOR-4 (Ctrl+C/V clone OKN-99 → save KOPIA-1 → mongo prostokat offset ~0.02 → editor Delete → archive) were NOT tested by the sub-agent because they require pixel-precise raw mouse choreography on the stage which is inherently flaky under Playwright. Recommendation: self-verify manually OR expose dedicated testIDs on shape hit-boxes and handles to enable stable coordinate resolution (e.g. testID={`wshape-${el.id}`} on the outer Pressable in GeometryEditor + testID={`handle-br-${el.id}`} on the bottom-right handle), then this sub-agent can retest deterministically.
(Non-blocking) Migrate remaining shadow*/textShadow* style props to boxShadow/textShadow to silence RN 0.76+ deprecation warnings.
(Non-blocking) Fix Reanimated 'reading value during render' warning by relocating shared-value reads into useDerivedValue/useAnimatedStyle.

context_for_next_testing_agent: For pixel-precise editor interactions (WEB-EDITOR-1..4: marquee/drag/resize/copy-paste) — the current GeometryEditor renders shapes as pointerEvents='none' <View>s inside a stage that listens to raw document mouse events. There are NO per-shape testIDs on the web editor path (unlike the read-only mobile path which exposes [data-testid^=shape-]). To make those flows deterministic, ask main agent to add: (a) testID={`wshape-${el.id}`} to the outer rect View in ShapeView (must remove pointerEvents='none' or use a sibling hit-target so Playwright can bounding_box() it), and (b) testID={`whandle-${dir}-${el.id}`} on the 4 resize handles. Then coordinate math becomes trivial via elementHandle.bounding_box(). Login: use 'haslo' (not 'password') in POST /api/auth/login; response returns 'access_token' (not 'token').
